summary: Frontend-only smoke test after client swapped in real photos and new bio. Verified every hero/gallery/print/journal/portrait image loads (naturalWidth>0, 0 broken), all titles/bio phrases render, western lightbox + journal modal fully functional (open/next/prev/close/Escape/backdrop), prints inquiry prefill works (subject + inquiry_type=print button active), contact form submits successfully and persists to /api/inquiries. No console errors. No 'Made with Emergent' badge.
critical_code_review_comments: Journal.jsx uses button-only list items (no child) with hover-preview image via AnimatePresence. This is fine functionally, but the review request mentioned 'journal-item-0..2 open modal with images that load' — image loading is verified only in modal (not in item itself). Not a bug, just note.
Content.js: all image srcs are correctly local paths (/hero-sunburst.jpg, /west-*.jpg, /travel-*.jpg, /portrait.png) and all files exist in /app/frontend/public/.
About.jsx bio has the multi-paragraph new copy including phrases 'drawn to the edges of things' and 'the world becomes simple again' — both verified.

Contact.jsx inquiry_type is React-state driven (button toggle group) rather than a DOM input — verified visually via contact-type-print button gaining bg-clay active class after print-inquire-0 click.
index.html hero preload for /hero-sunburst.jpg is correct.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth on this app
seed_data_creation: Submitted one test inquiry via contact form (TEST_John Doe / TEST_johndoe@example.com) which persisted successfully to /api/inquiries.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
All 10 test requirements from iteration 10 pass. Detailed verification: (a) Hero image /hero-sunburst.jpg loads (nw=2200), headline 'Where the light\nstill runs wild.' rendered (broken across
so full string match needs 'Where the light' + 'runs wild' pieces). (b) Western: all 5 items western-item-0..4 render images with nw>0, tiles fully filled (grid rows md:row-span-2 + object-cover, sizes 928x384, 452x384, 571x384, 809x384, 1404x384). Titles all present. Lightbox open/next/prev/close/Escape all work. (c) Travel: all 4 items load correct sources including /travel-stpauls.jpg (nw=1355). All titles present. Clicking travel item does NOT open lightbox (correct). (d) Prints: all 3 print items load. print-inquire-0 sets subject='Print inquiry — The Catch' AND toggles contact-type-print button to active (bg-clay class) — inquiry_type='print' state set correctly. (e) Journal: journal-item-0..2 open journal-modal with image loaded (nw=1700). Modal closes via Escape AND backdrop click AND close X. Note: journal items themselves don't contain element (they're text-only buttons; image shown as hover preview via AnimatePresence motion.img — but not required by spec). (f) About portrait /portrait.png loads (nw=503), both required bio phrases present. (g) Zero broken images (14 total imgs on page, 0 with nw=0). (h) Contact form submit works — toast 'Thank you — your message is on its way to Bill.' shown; GET /api/inquiries returns 200 with the submitted TEST_ record. (i) No console errors, no 'Made with Emergent' badge in DOM. Testing done with lenis destroyed for reliable scrollIntoView.
